The "Unemployment - Women Trends" chart is now showing Illinois and Michigan together on the open tab (americashealthrankings.org, Unemployment - Women, State Comparison view). I can't see the rendered image, so I can't read the year-by-year trend values. The page text only gives the chart's title, "Percentage of the female civilian workforce that is unemployed," and its legend, Illinois and Michigan. The source is the Bureau of Labor Statistics Local Area Unemployment Statistics Program.

The 2024 values for each state, from the state map:
- **Illinois:** 4.4%, ranked 43rd.
- **Michigan:** 3.7%.
- **United States:** 3.9%.

To get the figure, I did the following:
1. I opened the "Unemployment - Women" measure page.
2. I went to the Illinois version of that page.
3. I clicked "Compare States" in the Trends section.
4. I added Michigan.
